episodes.title: Chapter I: Wednesday's Child Is Full of Woe
episodes.summary: When a deliciously wicked prank gets Wednesday expelled, her parents ship her off to Nevermore Academy, the boarding school where they fell in love.

episodes.title: Chapter II: Woe Is the Loneliest Number
episodes.summary: The sheriff questions Wednesday about the night's strange happenings. Later, Wednesday faces off against a fierce rival in the cutthroat Poe Cup race.

episodes.title: Chapter III: Friend or Woe
episodes.summary: Wednesday stumbles on a secret society. During Outreach Day, Nevermore's outcasts mingle with Jericho's normies in Pilgrim World. Fudge, anyone?

episodes.title: Chapter IV: Woe What a Night
episodes.summary: Wednesday asks Xavier to the Rave'N dance, sparking Tyler's jealousy — but Thing's got something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Eugene stakes out the cave.

episodes.title: Chapter V: You Reap What You Woe
episodes.summary: During Parents Weekend, Wednesday digs into her family's past — and accidentally gets her dad arrested. Enid feels the pressure to "wolf out."

episodes.title: Chapter VI: Quid Pro Woe
episodes.summary: Wednesday's friends throw her a surprise birthday party. They mean well... but she'd much rather mark the miserable occasion by solving the murders.

episodes.title: Chapter VII: If You Don't Woe Me by Now
episodes.summary: Kooky Uncle Fester pays a visit and shares his theory about the monster. Wednesday begrudgingly agrees to a date with Tyler at Crackstone's crypt.

episodes.title: Chapter VIII: A Murder of Woes
episodes.summary: Wednesday lands in trouble with Principal Weems, but that's just the start of her problems. To fight an ancient evil, she'll need all her friends' help.

episodes.title: Chapter I: Here We Woe Again
episodes.summary: After a productive summer break, Wednesday returns to Nevermore as a grudging campus celebrity — and the target of a dangerous stalker.

episodes.title: Chapter II: The Devil You Woe
episodes.summary: Chaos reigns on campus as Nevermore celebrates its annual Prank Day. Wednesday confronts an old enemy and gains an unwanted ally.

episodes.title: Chapter III: Call of the Woe
episodes.summary: Stripped of both her ability and Goody's book, Wednesday is forced to do some old-fashioned detective work on a school camping trip.

episodes.title: Chapter IV: If These Woes Could Talk
episodes.summary: It's an Addams family investigation as Fester and Thing commit themselves to Wednesday's case. Trying to conceal one secret, Bianca stumbles on another.

episodes.title: Chapter V: Hyde and Woe Seek
episodes.summary: With Tyler on the loose, Wednesday readies for a risky Día de los Muertos showdown. Slurp's growing hunger poses problems for Pugsley.

episodes.title: Chapter VI: Woe Thyself
episodes.summary: An encounter with a spirit from Nevermore's past gives Wednesday and Enid a new perspective on one another — and puts one of their classmates in danger.

episodes.title: Chapter VII: Woe Me the Money
episodes.summary: As the school gala looms, Wednesday digs up dirt on Dort, Enid tries not to wolf out and Morticia engages in a battle of wills with Grandmama.

episodes.title: Chapter VIII: This Means Woe
episodes.summary: When buried family secrets are unearthed, Wednesday must race against time to prevent a dark prophecy from being realized.
